summary: This PR closes three tech-debt items and adds one new validation rule: a `no-model` API-key status so a stale `MODEL_CANDIDATES` list stops being reported as a bad key (TD-039), an `onNotice` model-fallback callback plumbed through every `IAiService` entry point via a new `advancePastRetiredModel` helper that de-duplicates five drifted copies (TD-041), numeric/non-array handling in `alignBatchResults` (TD-042), a Composite Check error for zero ingredient quantities, and Playwright fixes replacing fixed sleeps with `expect.poll`. The production code is sound — the helper extraction is correct, the new tests genuinely fail if the behaviour is removed, and the zero-qty guard is safe against whitespace and empty cells because `rowVals` normalises through `String(val || '').trim()`. No blocking-handbook violations and nothing high or critical. The findings are all documentation-integrity, test-strength, and one accessibility gap.
